question.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
A supported comparison would require direct, citable evidence that ties together the Aerospace / Defense use case, our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution, and the named competitor; the current passages only separately show “Aerospace & Defense Test” [97] and “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer” [99].  
### Evidence required before making a comparison
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| A named competitor and source type, preferably competitor official datasheet, application note, or credible third-party test report | R&S battle-card descriptions of competitors require Keysight official data or third-party data for validation, and the cited battle card lacks Keysight formal datasheets, document version, order number, option code, release status, and test conditions [49]. | Current competitor evidence is not enough if it is only a URL or uncited sales material; one raw passage is only a URL [98]. |
| Direct evidence that the competitor solution is for Aerospace / Defense and specifically covers Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer roles | The current passages separately mention Aerospace & Defense Test [97] and Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer [99], but they do not state a competitor comparison or a competitor solution tied to those roles. | Gap: no passage directly connects a named competitor, Aerospace / Defense, and Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in one supported comparison [97][99]. |
| Formal R&S product specifications for the exact Signal Generator and Signal Analyzer configuration | SMW200A formal specifications and configuration guide are the sources for RF/baseband performance, interfaces, environmental data, ordering information, options, mandatory configuration, compatibility, retrofitting notes, and service notes [3]. | R&S SMW200A evidence exists at product-spec/configuration level, but the exact offered configuration still must be tied to the target use case and options [3][61]. |
| Formal R&S FSW specifications and option evidence for analyzer frequency range, bandwidth, and options | FSW formal specifications are the authority for frequency/bandwidth/options, while summary/application material does not replace formal FSW specifications [11]. | FSW model and option evidence exists, including model frequency ranges [70] and analysis bandwidth options up to 8.312 GHz under stated applicability limits [67]. |
| Competitor specs with the same parameters and conditions as the R&S configuration | Sales battle-card competitor claims cannot be treated as official competitor specifications; competitor figures such as Anritsu FR3 / FR2 numbers are stated to come only from an R&S battle card and cannot be viewed as Anritsu official specs [21]. | Gap: no competitor official SG/SA datasheet, option stack, measurement conditions, or uncertainty is provided in the passages [21][49]. |
| Test scenario and measurement need for Aerospace / Defense | Aerospace / Defense-related standards and test areas in the passages include military / aviation drone EMC and EME testing, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, and RTCA DO-160 as standards lines, but these pages are not formal standards and do not define complete test methods, limits, or required items for a specific product [17][86]. | Gap: no passage states the exact A&D test case, DUT, standard clause, frequency range, power level, modulation, limit, pass/fail criterion, or safety/legal authorization for the intended SG/SA comparison [17][86]. |
| Measurement conditions, calibration, and uncertainty basis | SMW200A product data applies only under stated conditions such as storage, warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments, and non-warranted terms such as typ., nominal, and measured are not guaranteed [2]. | Any comparison must separate warranted specs from typ./nom./meas. values and preserve test conditions [2]. |
| Application-level evidence must be marked as application-level, not formal specification | Satellite payload testing material positions FSW + SMW200A for complete payload testing, but it is an application brochure and does not replace product datasheets, option requirements, or complete qualification plans [56][58]. | Application notes can support use-case relevance, but not binding performance claims or competitor superiority without formal specs and conditions [58]. |
| Recommended configurations must be checked against formal configuration and availability sources | NTN solution slides are not formal datasheets, configuration guides, price books, or 3GPP specifications, and recommended configurations are not directly quoteable BOMs; formal configuration guide, option availability, export control, and service plan must be checked [72]. | Any SG/SA “solution” comparison must verify options, export control, service, and availability before being used commercially [72]. |
### What can be said now
The passages support that R&S SMW200A is a vector signal generator with configurations up to two internal RF paths, up to 8 signal sources with external SGT100A modules, up to 64 fading channels, and RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz in wideband baseband [1].  
The passages support that R&S FSW is a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer family covering models from 8 GHz to 85 GHz, with FSW85 extendable to 90 GHz using R&S FSW-B90G [66].  
The passages support that FSW analysis bandwidth options include 40 MHz, 80 MHz, 160 MHz, 320 MHz, 512 MHz, 1.2 GHz, 2 GHz, 4.4 GHz, 6.4 GHz, and 8.312 GHz, with model and availability restrictions stated in the option table [67].  
The passages support that FSW + SMW200A are recommended for complete satellite payload testing covering group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality [59].  
The passages do not provide a supported Aerospace / Defense competitor comparison for our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution; they only separately mention Aerospace & Defense Test [97], Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer [99], and a competitor/vendor context that requires official or third-party validation before use [49].

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing
[[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中引用 [[RTCA DO-160]] 作為 airborne equipment environmental conditions and test procedures 的測試線索，用於 military / aviation drone EMC proposal context。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 [[RTCA DO-160]] 正式標準摘要；只保存 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 的簡報文字。
- 不得由本頁推論 DO-160G / DO-160 任何 section 的完整 category、limit、waveform、test setup 或 pass / fail criteria。
- 來源把 DO-160 放在 military / aviation drone example 中，但未說明特定 drone、eVTOL 或 avionics equipment 的 qualification plan。

軍用無人機 EMC 與 EME testing › 與 standard EMC test 的差異
[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 對 system level EME effects test 與 standard EMC test 的差異描述包含：

- system level 依 requirements operate in fixed / operational environment。
- operational environmental conditions may have no definition。
- 分析 EM interference，涵蓋 time and frequency domain。
- standard EMC test 則 according to test methods、frequency domain、research and design work 等。

來源排版破碎，以上只保留可見語句，不延伸成正式測試方法。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 典型 setup 元件
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 的 TVAC test setup 可包含：

- signal generator
- RF switching matrix
- signal analyzer
- network analyzer
- multimeter
- DC power system
- laptop / PC remote operation
- test interface
- TVAC
- satellite or satellite components
- bulkhead connector interface

來源標示 TVAC setup 中距離為 10 m to 25 m。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 測試問題
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。
- Commercial off-the-shelf test and measurement equipment 無法在 TVAC conditions 下工作。
- Spectrum analyzers、vector network analyzers、signal generators 等設備必須留在 TVAC 外部，並以長 cables 連接 chamber 內的 DUT。
- Test setup 中的 cables、adapters 與 switches 會隨 TVAC temperature changes 發生 drift。
- 在不同 temperature 下於 chamber 中完成的 calibration 不再有效。
- 移動 cables 與改變 temperatures 後，需要 regular recalibration 以確保 measurement accuracy。
- TVAC 內 calibration procedure 特別困難，因 vacuum applied 時 operator 無法進入 chamber。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 使用限制

Starlink User Terminal › Recommended RF test equipment
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 推薦：

- Spectrum analyzer：[[R&S FSW]]（43.5 GHz、POI 0.46 µs）、Keysight N9040B UXA。
- Signal generator：[[R&S SMW200A]]（100 kHz–31.8 GHz）、Keysight E8257D PSG。
- Power meter：[[R&S NRX]] with NRP33S（±2.5 dB abs）、Bird 43 wattmeter。
- VNA：Keysight PNA-X（67 GHz）、[[R&S ZNA]] for array calibration。
- Satellite simulator：Terma Ku/Ka-band for loopback EIRP / G/T testing。

這些是該 deck 的推薦清單；正式頻率範圍、POI、功率不確定度、option 需求與 order number 必須回查各產品 datasheet。

Starlink User Terminal › DVT / PVT test flow
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 列出 key steps：

- Functional test：power on、stow、normal / obstructed state check。
- RF emissions：anechoic chamber、FCC Part 15 / 25 limits、spurious <-43 dBc。
- EIRP / G/T：spectrum analyzer + power meter measurement、validate against target。
- Modulation BER：connect to gateway simulator、QPSK / 64QAM threshold test。
- Environmental：thermal cycle、drop / vibration、IP67 salt spray、snowmelt power。

更完整測試流程另見 [[Starlink User Terminal 測試流程]]。

Starlink User Terminal › Phased array evolution
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 以 beamformer impact 比較三個版本：

| 版本 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| V1 Circular | 79 DBFs、1,264 elements、motors、NF 3–4 dB |
| Rev3 Gen2 | 16 Shiraz、1,536 elements、NF 2.5–3 dB |
| Rev4 Gen3 | 6 Shiraz daisy-chain、1,536 elements、NF 2–2.5 dB、110° FOV |

來源另稱 Rev4 gains：

- Jitter 9 ms vs 112 ms Rev3。
- Down 307 Mbps。
- Power efficiency +50%。

這些數字連到 [[相控陣列天線]] 與 [[Beamforming]] 主題，但來源未提供 teardown、FCC filing、SpaceX 官方文件或第三方測試報告。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 與 NR-NTN conformance testing 的區分
[[NR-NTN conformance testing]] 既有頁主要整理 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]]、[[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]、[[R&S TS-RRM]]、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 UE / chipset conformance validation PR 語境。

本頁的 [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 則聚焦 [[Satellite Access Node]]、[[3GPP TS 38.108]] / [[3GPP TS 38.181]]、SAN transmitter / receiver / performance / OTA chapters，以及 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator / channel emulator 配置。兩者同屬 NTN conformance testing，但測試對象、規格與儀器角色不同。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 測試對象與架構
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 18，測試對象是 Satellite Access Node（DUT），transparent payload architecture。圖中文字包含：

- Gateway。
- NTN Payload RF。
- gNB。
- Feeder Link Emulator。
- Signal generator。
- Channel emulator for service link。
- Throughput measurement point。

來源 slide 6 說 [[3GPP]] Specification Work in Release 17 and Release 18 focuses on transparent bent-pipe payload architecture。SAN provides NR user plane and control plane protocol terminations towards NTN satellite-capable UE，connected via NG interface to 5GC，and encompasses a transparent NTN payload onboard a NTN platform、a gateway and gNB functions。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › SAN conformance requirements chapters
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 33：

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 7：Conducted receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 11：Radiated performance characteristics。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 來源主張
- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully validated high-throughput performance of a [[5G NR]] connection at **13 GHz**。
- 來源明示 proposed [[FR3]] frequency range 為 **7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz**。
- 來源說 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 的 5G mobile test platform（MTP）使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] in a maximum throughput use case at 13 GHz。
- 來源稱該 achievement confirms the potential of [[FR3]] to deliver high data rates using high [[MCS]]，並透過 [[4x4 MIMO]] enhanced capacity。
- 來源未提到 [[RFU18]]，也未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 13 GHz hardware / software configuration。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]（來源未標示 published date；raw created 2026-09-11；demo 日期 March 2 to 5, 2026）：

- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully demonstrated carrier aggregation across [[FR1]] and [[FR3]] frequency ranges。
- Demo 聚合約 **2.5 GHz** [[FR1]] channel 與約 **7 GHz** [[FR3]] channel，兩 band 均使用 [[4x4 MIMO]] 與 higher-order modulation。
- Test setup 核心是 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester，extended with new [[RFU18]] board to provide coverage up to **18 GHz**。
- 來源稱 [[RFU18]] is a modular hardware upgrade for the [[R&S CMX500]] platform，讓 existing testers extend towards [[6G]]。

### Short answer
A supported comparison would require direct, citable evidence that ties together the Aerospace / Defense use case, our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution, and the named competitor; the current passages only separately show “Aerospace & Defense Test” [97] and “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer” [99].  
### Evidence required before making a comparison
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| A named competitor and source type, preferably competitor official datasheet, application note, or credible third-party test report | R&S battle-card descriptions of competitors require Keysight official data or third-party data for validation, and the cited battle card lacks Keysight formal datasheets, document version, order number, option code, release status, and test conditions [49]. | Current competitor evidence is not enough if it is only a URL or uncited sales material; one raw passage is only a URL [98]. |
| Direct evidence that the competitor solution is for Aerospace / Defense and specifically covers Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer roles | The current passages separately mention Aerospace & Defense Test [97] and Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer [99], but they do not state a competitor comparison or a competitor solution tied to those roles. | Gap: no passage directly connects a named competitor, Aerospace / Defense, and Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in one supported comparison [97][99]. |
| Formal R&S product specifications for the exact Signal Generator and Signal Analyzer configuration | SMW200A formal specifications and configuration guide are the sources for RF/baseband performance, interfaces, environmental data, ordering information, options, mandatory configuration, compatibility, retrofitting notes, and service notes [3]. | R&S SMW200A evidence exists at product-spec/configuration level, but the exact offered configuration still must be tied to the target use case and options [3][61]. |
| Formal R&S FSW specifications and option evidence for analyzer frequency range, bandwidth, and options | FSW formal specifications are the authority for frequency/bandwidth/options, while summary/application material does not replace formal FSW specifications [11]. | FSW model and option evidence exists, including model frequency ranges [70] and analysis bandwidth options up to 8.312 GHz under stated applicability limits [67]. |
| Competitor specs with the same parameters and conditions as the R&S configuration | Sales battle-card competitor claims cannot be treated as official competitor specifications; competitor figures such as Anritsu FR3 / FR2 numbers are stated to come only from an R&S battle card and cannot be viewed as Anritsu official specs [21]. | Gap: no competitor official SG/SA datasheet, option stack, measurement conditions, or uncertainty is provided in the passages [21][49]. |
| Test scenario and measurement need for Aerospace / Defense | Aerospace / Defense-related standards and test areas in the passages include military / aviation drone EMC and EME testing, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, and RTCA DO-160 as standards lines, but these pages are not formal standards and do not define complete test methods, limits, or required items for a specific product [17][86]. | Gap: no passage states the exact A&D test case, DUT, standard clause, frequency range, power level, modulation, limit, pass/fail criterion, or safety/legal authorization for the intended SG/SA comparison [17][86]. |
| Measurement conditions, calibration, and uncertainty basis | SMW200A product data applies only under stated conditions such as storage, warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments, and non-warranted terms such as typ., nominal, and measured are not guaranteed [2]. | Any comparison must separate warranted specs from typ./nom./meas. values and preserve test conditions [2]. |
| Application-level evidence must be marked as application-level, not formal specification | Satellite payload testing material positions FSW + SMW200A for complete payload testing, but it is an application brochure and does not replace product datasheets, option requirements, or complete qualification plans [56][58]. | Application notes can support use-case relevance, but not binding performance claims or competitor superiority without formal specs and conditions [58]. |
| Recommended configurations must be checked against formal configuration and availability sources | NTN solution slides are not formal datasheets, configuration guides, price books, or 3GPP specifications, and recommended configurations are not directly quoteable BOMs; formal configuration guide, option availability, export control, and service plan must be checked [72]. | Any SG/SA “solution” comparison must verify options, export control, service, and availability before being used commercially [72]. |
### What can be said now
The passages support that R&S SMW200A is a vector signal generator with configurations up to two internal RF paths, up to 8 signal sources with external SGT100A modules, up to 64 fading channels, and RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz in wideband baseband [1].  
The passages support that R&S FSW is a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer family covering models from 8 GHz to 85 GHz, with FSW85 extendable to 90 GHz using R&S FSW-B90G [66].  
The passages support that FSW analysis bandwidth options include 40 MHz, 80 MHz, 160 MHz, 320 MHz, 512 MHz, 1.2 GHz, 2 GHz, 4.4 GHz, 6.4 GHz, and 8.312 GHz, with model and availability restrictions stated in the option table [67].  
The passages support that FSW + SMW200A are recommended for complete satellite payload testing covering group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality [59].  
The passages do not provide a supported Aerospace / Defense competitor comparison for our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution; they only separately mention Aerospace & Defense Test [97], Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer [99], and a competitor/vendor context that requires official or third-party validation before use [49].

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 典型 setup 元件
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 的 TVAC test setup 可包含：

- signal generator
- RF switching matrix
- signal analyzer
- network analyzer
- multimeter
- DC power system
- laptop / PC remote operation
- test interface
- TVAC
- satellite or satellite components
- bulkhead connector interface

來源標示 TVAC setup 中距離為 10 m to 25 m。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 測試問題
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。
- Commercial off-the-shelf test and measurement equipment 無法在 TVAC conditions 下工作。
- Spectrum analyzers、vector network analyzers、signal generators 等設備必須留在 TVAC 外部，並以長 cables 連接 chamber 內的 DUT。
- Test setup 中的 cables、adapters 與 switches 會隨 TVAC temperature changes 發生 drift。
- 在不同 temperature 下於 chamber 中完成的 calibration 不再有效。
- 移動 cables 與改變 temperatures 後，需要 regular recalibration 以確保 measurement accuracy。
- TVAC 內 calibration procedure 特別困難，因 vacuum applied 時 operator 無法進入 chamber。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 推薦：

- Spectrum analyzer：[[R&S FSW]]（43.5 GHz、POI 0.46 µs）、Keysight N9040B UXA。
- Signal generator：[[R&S SMW200A]]（100 kHz–31.8 GHz）、Keysight E8257D PSG。

Starlink User Terminal › DVT / PVT test flow
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 列出 key steps：

- Functional test：power on、stow、normal / obstructed state check。
- RF emissions：anechoic chamber、FCC Part 15 / 25 limits、spurious <-43 dBc。
- EIRP / G/T：spectrum analyzer + power meter measurement、validate against target。
- Modulation BER：connect to gateway simulator、QPSK / 64QAM threshold test。
- Environmental：thermal cycle、drop / vibration、IP67 salt spray、snowmelt power。

更完整測試流程另見 [[Starlink User Terminal 測試流程]]。

Starlink User Terminal › Phased array evolution
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 以 beamformer impact 比較三個版本：

| 版本 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| V1 Circular | 79 DBFs、1,264 elements、motors、NF 3–4 dB |
| Rev3 Gen2 | 16 Shiraz、1,536 elements、NF 2.5–3 dB |
| Rev4 Gen3 | 6 Shiraz daisy-chain、1,536 elements、NF 2–2.5 dB、110° FOV |

來源另稱 Rev4 gains：

- Jitter 9 ms vs 112 ms Rev3。
- Down 307 Mbps。
- Power efficiency +50%。

這些數字連到 [[相控陣列天線]] 與 [[Beamforming]] 主題，但來源未提供 teardown、FCC filing、SpaceX 官方文件或第三方測試報告。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 與 NR-NTN conformance testing 的區分
[[NR-NTN conformance testing]] 既有頁主要整理 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]]、[[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]、[[R&S TS-RRM]]、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 UE / chipset conformance validation PR 語境。

本頁的 [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 則聚焦 [[Satellite Access Node]]、[[3GPP TS 38.108]] / [[3GPP TS 38.181]]、SAN transmitter / receiver / performance / OTA chapters，以及 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator / channel emulator 配置。兩者同屬 NTN conformance testing，但測試對象、規格與儀器角色不同。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 測試對象與架構
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 18，測試對象是 Satellite Access Node（DUT），transparent payload architecture。圖中文字包含：

- Gateway。
- NTN Payload RF。
- gNB。
- Feeder Link Emulator。
- Signal generator。
- Channel emulator for service link。
- Throughput measurement point。

來源 slide 6 說 [[3GPP]] Specification Work in Release 17 and Release 18 focuses on transparent bent-pipe payload architecture。SAN provides NR user plane and control plane protocol terminations towards NTN satellite-capable UE，connected via NG interface to 5GC，and encompasses a transparent NTN payload onboard a NTN platform、a gateway and gNB functions。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › SAN conformance requirements chapters
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 33：

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 7：Conducted receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。

FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張 › 來源主張
- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully validated high-throughput performance of a [[5G NR]] connection at **13 GHz**。
- 來源明示 proposed [[FR3]] frequency range 為 **7.125 GHz to 24.25 GHz**。
- 來源說 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 的 5G mobile test platform（MTP）使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] in a maximum throughput use case at 13 GHz。
- 來源稱該 achievement confirms the potential of [[FR3]] to deliver high data rates using high [[MCS]]，並透過 [[4x4 MIMO]] enhanced capacity。
- 來源未提到 [[RFU18]]，也未提供 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 13 GHz hardware / software configuration。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness]]（來源未標示 published date；raw created 2026-09-11；demo 日期 March 2 to 5, 2026）：

- 來源說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully demonstrated carrier aggregation across [[FR1]] and [[FR3]] frequency ranges。
- Demo 聚合約 **2.5 GHz** [[FR1]] channel 與約 **7 GHz** [[FR3]] channel，兩 band 均使用 [[4x4 MIMO]] 與 higher-order modulation。
- Test setup 核心是 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester，extended with new [[RFU18]] board to provide coverage up to **18 GHz**。
- 來源稱 [[RFU18]] is a modular hardware upgrade for the [[R&S CMX500]] platform，讓 existing testers extend towards [[6G]]。

### Short answer
A supported comparison would require direct, citable evidence that ties together the Aerospace / Defense use case, our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution, and the named competitor; the current passages only separately show “Aerospace & Defense Test” [97] and “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer” [99].  
### Evidence required before making a comparison
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| A named competitor and source type, preferably competitor official datasheet, application note, or credible third-party test report | R&S battle-card descriptions of competitors require Keysight official data or third-party data for validation, and the cited battle card lacks Keysight formal datasheets, document version, order number, option code, release status, and test conditions [49]. | Current competitor evidence is not enough if it is only a URL or uncited sales material; one raw passage is only a URL [98]. |
| Direct evidence that the competitor solution is for Aerospace / Defense and specifically covers Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer roles | The current passages separately mention Aerospace & Defense Test [97] and Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer [99], but they do not state a competitor comparison or a competitor solution tied to those roles. | Gap: no passage directly connects a named competitor, Aerospace / Defense, and Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in one supported comparison [97][99]. |
| Formal R&S product specifications for the exact Signal Generator and Signal Analyzer configuration | SMW200A formal specifications and configuration guide are the sources for RF/baseband performance, interfaces, environmental data, ordering information, options, mandatory configuration, compatibility, retrofitting notes, and service notes [3]. | R&S SMW200A evidence exists at product-spec/configuration level, but the exact offered configuration still must be tied to the target use case and options [3][61]. |
| Formal R&S FSW specifications and option evidence for analyzer frequency range, bandwidth, and options | FSW formal specifications are the authority for frequency/bandwidth/options, while summary/application material does not replace formal FSW specifications [11]. | FSW model and option evidence exists, including model frequency ranges [70] and analysis bandwidth options up to 8.312 GHz under stated applicability limits [67]. |
| Competitor specs with the same parameters and conditions as the R&S configuration | Sales battle-card competitor claims cannot be treated as official competitor specifications; competitor figures such as Anritsu FR3 / FR2 numbers are stated to come only from an R&S battle card and cannot be viewed as Anritsu official specs [21]. | Gap: no competitor official SG/SA datasheet, option stack, measurement conditions, or uncertainty is provided in the passages [21][49]. |
| Test scenario and measurement need for Aerospace / Defense | Aerospace / Defense-related standards and test areas in the passages include military / aviation drone EMC and EME testing, MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, and RTCA DO-160 as standards lines, but these pages are not formal standards and do not define complete test methods, limits, or required items for a specific product [17][86]. | Gap: no passage states the exact A&D test case, DUT, standard clause, frequency range, power level, modulation, limit, pass/fail criterion, or safety/legal authorization for the intended SG/SA comparison [17][86]. |
| Measurement conditions, calibration, and uncertainty basis | SMW200A product data applies only under stated conditions such as storage, warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments, and non-warranted terms such as typ., nominal, and measured are not guaranteed [2]. | Any comparison must separate warranted specs from typ./nom./meas. values and preserve test conditions [2]. |
| Application-level evidence must be marked as application-level, not formal specification | Satellite payload testing material positions FSW + SMW200A for complete payload testing, but it is an application brochure and does not replace product datasheets, option requirements, or complete qualification plans [56][58]. | Application notes can support use-case relevance, but not binding performance claims or competitor superiority without formal specs and conditions [58]. |
| Recommended configurations must be checked against formal configuration and availability sources | NTN solution slides are not formal datasheets, configuration guides, price books, or 3GPP specifications, and recommended configurations are not directly quoteable BOMs; formal configuration guide, option availability, export control, and service plan must be checked [72]. | Any SG/SA “solution” comparison must verify options, export control, service, and availability before being used commercially [72]. |
### What can be said now
The passages support that R&S SMW200A is a vector signal generator with configurations up to two internal RF paths, up to 8 signal sources with external SGT100A modules, up to 64 fading channels, and RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz in wideband baseband [1].  
The passages support that R&S FSW is a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer family covering models from 8 GHz to 85 GHz, with FSW85 extendable to 90 GHz using R&S FSW-B90G [66].  
The passages support that FSW analysis bandwidth options include 40 MHz, 80 MHz, 160 MHz, 320 MHz, 512 MHz, 1.2 GHz, 2 GHz, 4.4 GHz, 6.4 GHz, and 8.312 GHz, with model and availability restrictions stated in the option table [67].  
The passages support that FSW + SMW200A are recommended for complete satellite payload testing covering group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality [59].  
The passages do not provide a supported Aerospace / Defense competitor comparison for our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution; they only separately mention Aerospace & Defense Test [97], Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer [99], and a competitor/vendor context that requires official or third-party validation before use [49].
